name: luoxiaohei
author: JRHU0048
variant_note: Independently AI-generated 3D toy-style v2 edition by JRHU0048. One animated WebP contains three complete atlases in this fixed 30-second cycle: black cat, black-haired child, white-haired child, 10 seconds each. The cat has broad angular triangular ears with smooth pale-green inner panels. Distinct from the existing single-form editions by legeling and makashibata.
source_notes: Unofficial fan-art project inspired by The Legend of Luo Xiaohei (罗小黑战记). The final sprite artwork was generated and refined with OpenAI built-in image generation under JRHU0048's direction using private user-supplied 3D and 2D references for visual guidance. Reference images are not redistributed and were not directly cropped or traced into this package. The three forms are described visually; no claim is made about the official identity of the white-haired form. Adapted from the submitter's approved local pet; gallery copy uses near-lossless WebP compression with original alpha preserved to meet the 5 MB limit. Runtime reloading or cloud conversion to PNG can reset or remove the form cycle; retain this animated local WebP. The gallery preview generator currently displays the first atlas only.
